board: SparkFun Current Sensor Breakout - ACS723 (Low Current), SEN-14544 (ACS723LLCTR-05AB + OPA344 amplifier, header VCC/VO/GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring at 5 V, design checks, breadboard, simulator test I=1.5A, DRC-clean PCB, footprint, LCSC C2655492). Model follows the chip datasheet (VCC/2 + 400 mV/A) and the board schematic's inverting OPA344 stage, VO = Vref + G(Vref - VIOUT). The sim fixes one trimmer setting (G=2, Vref=VCC/2), so VO = 2.5 V - 0.8 V/A x I. The driver takes a calibrated zero and sensitivity.
breakoutPinoutSource: SparkFun ACS723 Low Current Eagle files (ACS723_Low_Current_Sensor.zip, board silkscreen VCC/VO/GND on JP3 pins 1-3) and schematic v10 https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/2/3/c/8/7/ACS723_Low_Current_Sensor.pdf
